name: Calamus Reservoir SRA - Valley View Flat Campground
note: Small campground near the upper (northwest) end of Calamus Reservoir, on its own road off the highway: one paved loop of electric pads under mature trees, set back from the boat ramp and parking lots; tent sites and designated parking-lot spots alongside. Shower house here; the park's dump station is at Little York Point. Park entry permit required. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: NGPC Calamus Reservoir page (outdoornebraska.gov, Wayback capture 2026-08-18: 'Shower houses are available at Homestead Knolls, Nunda Shoal and Valley View Flat campgrounds'; 'this small area has a boat ramp, basic and electric plus camping, and showers') + NGPC 'Valley View Flat' campground map (PDF 13 Aug 2020, same capture): 10 Electric Plus sites 33-42 on one loop + ReserveAmerica park 230275 loop VALLEY VIEW FLAT read 2026-11-05: 9 sites (033-036, 038-042) Drive-In, Back-In, Paved, Electricity Hookup 50, Max Vehicle Length 50 (the loop's other 13 sites are Hike-In tent sites); calendar shows them FCFS ('W') through Apr 30 2027 and bookable online ('A') from May 1 2027 -> real NGPC drive-in RV campground. Public: no price gate. Separate place: 9.6 km from Homestead Knolls 2680 and 5.0 km from Nunda Shoal 2681, own access road off the highway.
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-05: NGPC Valley View Flat map (2020, drawn on an aerial) puts the electric loop (33-42) ~150-250 m NE of the lake, with the boat-ramp parking lots, restroom and tent area between; ReserveAmerica site records carry no Proximity to Water or waterfront attribute. Satellite: Esri World Imagery export at 41.9084,-99.2974 (0.008 x 0.006 deg, rendered) shows the paved loop under scattered/mature trees; nearest pad (042, RA GIS 41.90836,-99.29809) is ~170 m from the shoreline at the boat-ramp cove, across the ramp road and parking lots, and the shore to the NW is behind a continuous shelterbelt treeline and field. Developed/used strip and treeline between -> no on-water value, and no confirmed open sightline from RV pads -> not waterfront (unsure goes down). Dam check: Calamus Dam is at the reservoir's far SE end (~15 km); campground on the lake side, DEM 692 m at the pads vs ~681 m on the open water (above the lake, not below pool).

fees.note: In season: basic $15, electric plus $30 a night; $5 less mid-October through April. Plus tax, the $8.50 reservation fee when booked online, and a park entry permit ($7 a day for a Nebraska vehicle, $14 otherwise; $35 / $70 a year). Nebraska Game and Parks' camping rates grid ('These rates are consistent across all parks').

fees_source: https://outdoornebraska.gov/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/2025-Camping-Rates-Grid.pdf (row 'Calamus', statewide Electric Plus $30 / Basic $15) as already carried by sibling entry 2680; entry permit amounts from the ReserveAmerica Valley View Flat site pages' alert, read 2026-11-05
flags: Not on RV Life (Algolia bbox 41.80-41.98, -99.40 - -99.15 returns only Homestead Knolls, Nunda Shoal and Fort Knox), so no rating.
Pin is the centroid of the 9 RA GIS points (sites 033-036, 038-042), which sit on the loop drawn on the NGPC map. 9.6 km NW of Homestead Knolls 2680, 5.0 km N of Nunda Shoal 2681.

Structured data for stamping: hookups.electric 50 (RA per-site 'Electricity Hookup: 50' on all 9 drive-in sites, read 2026-11-05; the 2020 NGPC legend says 'Electric Plus 20/30 amp - dedicated water hook-up or 50 amp connection' generically, so water hookup left unknown, no sewer listed); sites.count 10 (NGPC map 2020: 'Total Number of Campsites - 10', all Electric Plus 33-42; RA sells 9, site 037 not on RA), max_rig_ft 50 (RA Max Vehicle Length 50 on all 9), all back-in, paved, no pull-throughs (RA Driveway Entry: Back-In); booking reservable on ReserveAmerica (platform reserveamerica, window 180 days: RA booking window 'Electric Plus ... up to 180 Day(s) in advance'), fcfs some_sites/seasonal: RA calendar 'W' (walk-up) through Apr 30 2027 and 'A' from May 1 2027 for all 9, NGPC page 'reservations are available during peak season for half of the electrical campsites ... All other camping is first-come, first-served' (Iron Ranger self-pay, cash/check); season: open year round (RA calendar shows walk-up 'W' in Nov 2026; RA status 'Open through Thu Sep 30 2027'); facilities: showers true, flush_toilets true, potable_water true (NGPC page: 'Shower houses ... at ... Valley View Flat'; 'mature shade trees, water and modern restrooms'), dump false here (park dump/fill at Little York Point), boat ramp in the area.
The 2020 NGPC map draws all 33-42 as 'Not Reservable' circles; ReserveAmerica now sells 9 of them for May-Sep, so the map predates the current reservation split.

Also at Valley View Flat (not counted as RV sites): 13 RA 'Hike-In' tent sites (005-025, 10 ft walk), a group tent area, and NGPC 'camping is permitted in the parking lots of the Valley View Flat and Hannaman Bayou campgrounds in designated spots' (Basic non-pad).
